message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on **June 18, 1815**, resulted in roughly **25,000 casualties** in total—about 12,000–13,000 killed or mortally wounded and another 10,000–11,000 wounded or missing. In terms of national totals:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~22,000 |

These figures include those killed, wounded, captured, and missing from both sides.
